tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the default theme; light is for long-read sections (programs detail, FAQ) and the kids/parents band.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards (program, instructor, schedule day) and the sticky header on scroll.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands and schedule row hover. Concrete in light.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-muted in both themes (16:1+ dark, 17:1+ light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions, schedule times. On surface, surface-raised and surface-muted: 6.0:1+ dark, 5.7:1+ light.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between schedule rows and around cards. Never the only thing separating interactive controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary button, chips, inputs). 3:1+ on surface, surface-raised and surface-muted in both themes.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, active schedule filter, key stats, focus ring. Use sparingly — about one signal moment per screen.

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed state.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill. Graphite on the bright dark-theme purple (5.3:1), white on the deeper light-theme purple (6.3:1). Never hardcode white.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind tags and the promo banner's highlight chip.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Purple text: links, tag labels, eyebrows. On surface, surface-raised, surface-muted and signal-soft: 6.9:1+ dark, 6.6:1+ light.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with 2px offset. 4.4:1+ on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline and the final call to action only. Uppercase, Archivo at condensed width (font-stretch 62%), stacked two or three words per line. 92px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers. Uppercase, condensed (font-stretch 62%). Let long ones wrap to two lines rather than shrinking. 72px on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Program-card titles. Uppercase, condensed. 44px on phones; instructor names use the same style at 32px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Schedule day names, instructor names. Sentence case, normal width.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Real self-defense, real conditioning, and a room that has your back.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: No gi needed. Show up in a rash guard and shorts.
styles.usage: Default body copy and card descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, button text. Uppercase. In signal-text or ink-muted.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Class times and prices, so columns line up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Schedule row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter, card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections (64px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Section bands, photo blocks, the schedule grid. The default: this brand is cut square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards — just enough to soften the pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and the schedule filter chips only.
